_comment: The layouts that ship with the package. The four express layouts place a
whole light chain and a whole heavy chain of a chosen isotype, which the
intrinsic parts (builtin_parts.json) resolve -- so they are buildable
from the antibody library alone, with no part named by the layout except
the signal peptides, linker and 2A elements the user supplies.

single_chain_bcr_igg1.label: Single chain BCR_IGG1
single_chain_bcr_igg1.description: Membrane-bound single-chain BCR: the whole light chain first, then a flexible linker, then the IgG1 heavy chain with CH1-CH3 and the transmembrane tail.

single_chain_bcr_igm.label: Single chain BCR_IGM
single_chain_bcr_igm.description: Membrane-bound single-chain BCR: the whole light chain first, then a flexible linker, then the IgM heavy chain with CH1-CH4 and the transmembrane tail.

2alinked_igg1.label: 2Alinked_IGG1
2alinked_igg1.description: Two chains from one open reading frame: the IgG1 heavy chain, a furin site and F2A, then the light chain, then T2A and EGFP as a transduction marker.

2alinked_igm.label: 2Alinked_IGM
2alinked_igm.description: Two chains from one open reading frame: the IgM heavy chain, a furin site and F2A, then the light chain, then T2A and EGFP as a transduction marker.
